name: AspectRatioImageFitter
src_typeComment: CSS object-fit for a RawImage: Contain sizes the image to fit entirely within its parent (letterboxed, never cropped); Cover sizes it to fill the parent entirely (cropped, never letterboxed — pair with a Mask/RectMask2D on the parent to actually clip the overflow). Reads the ASSIGNED texture's own aspect ratio automatically — unlike Unity's built-in AspectRatioFitter, which needs that ratio set by hand and has no Cover mode at all.

src_members.name: Refresh
src_members.comment: Call this after changing rawImage.texture at runtime, or after the parent container is resized — neither triggers this automatically, since there's no Unity layout-system hook for "a Texture reference changed."
